findings.quote: - Google was pushing the initiative as the party with the most to gain from browser-based apps; Mozilla, Opera, and Microsoft had already signed on.
findings.suggestion: Trocar “the initiative” por algo concreto e verificável do texto-base. Ex.: “Google was pushing Service Workers/PWAs as the party with the most to gain…; Mozilla, Opera, and Microsoft had already signed on.”

findings.quote: - Wide adoption would shift where the power sits: developers ship one app instead of one per OS, and users stop depending on app stores for installs and updates.
findings.suggestion: Cortar a moldura de efeito e ficar no mecanismo concreto. Ex.: “Wide adoption would let developers ship one app instead of one per OS, and could reduce dependence on app stores for installs and updates.”
